findings.title: Unreadable scope data can mark a tree covered
findings.description: `readSidecar` returns `null` when an existing `split.json` cannot be read or parsed, and `extractReviewRecord` treats a null sidecar as complete scope. If the adjacent `review.json` has complete coverage and an exact tree match, the gate can return 0 without checking whether the local diff omitted files.

findings.title: Invalid configuration exits as not covered
findings.description: `main` calls `loadFactory()` outside its error handling, and that function throws for an unreadable, malformed, or invalid configuration. When `factory.json` or `FAULTFORGE_CONFIG` is bad, the uncaught exception exits with status 1 instead of the gate’s status 2 for an input or evidence failure.

findings.title: Another repository's review can cover a tree
findings.description: `checkTree` rejects a foreign repository only when the review has a non-null `repo`, while records without a sidecar receive `repo: null`. If two configured repositories have identical trees, an unlabelled complete review from one can make the other report covered; the new test explicitly accepts that case.

findings.title: Unreadable folders can hide matching reviews
findings.description: `walk` silently returns when it cannot list an evidence directory, leaving `readReviewRecords` with a partial set of reviews. If another review remains readable, `main` proceeds to return 0 or 1 rather than exit 2, so a matching review in the unreadable folder can be reported as not covered.
